messages.note: Dagon falls twice beside the ark at Ashdod. In We The Nameless, the affliction that follows is hemorrhoids.

messages.note: The Philistine diviners send gold replicas of the mice and hemorrhoids along with the ark.

messages.title: you can take off the armor
messages.note: David tries Saul’s armor and takes it off in favor of his familiar tools.

messages.title: Re: cedar (REVISED)
messages.note: YHWH recalls traveling in a tent and says that David’s son will build a house for his name.

messages.title: tell Nathan i got it
messages.note: Nathan confronts David through a parable about a rich man taking a poor man’s only lamb.

messages.title: the donkey filed a complaint
messages.note: Balaam’s donkey sees the angel before Balaam does. YHWH’s argument with Mo recalls the burning bush in Exodus 3.

messages.title: leave the box where it is
messages.note: David sends Zadok and the ark back to Jerusalem as he flees the city.
